title: Stretch Blending and Buffing Face Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free

What it is: A brush that hugs the contours of your face to seamlessly buff Stretch Foundation and Concealer (each sold separately) into skin.


Brush Formulation: Liquid / Cream


Bristle Type: Synthetic


Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Hold the metal base. Push, flip, and click to open and close.
-Buff outward to seamlessly blend Stretch foundation and concealer (each sold separately) into skin.
-Use the targeted tip for hard-to-reach areas.

Recycling Instructions:
-The brush and bristles are recyclable.
